name: ai-commerce-assistant
description: Portfolio MVP for a local Ollama-powered B2B commerce assistant.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ai-commerce/shared && concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @ai-commerce/api" "npm run dev -w @ai-commerce/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-commerce/shared && npm run build -w @ai-commerce/api && npm run build -w @ai-commerce/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ai-commerce/shared && npm run test -w @ai-commerce/api && npm run test -w @ai-commerce/web && npm run test -w @ai-commerce/shared
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ai-commerce/shared && npm run lint -w @ai-commerce/api && npm run lint -w @ai-commerce/web
